paraphrase: We take refuge in him — the Lord who, in endless play, creates, sustains and removes all the worlds that are, and to whom alone we belong.
speaker: Kampaṉ
notes: The first invocation verse (kaṭavuḷ vāḻttu) of the Pāla Kāṇṭam: 'ulakam yāvaiyum tām uḷavākkalum ...'.
